text:
Max (eng-platform): FYI rolling firewall egress rule to restrict outbound to collector endpoints in eu-west started ~5m ago. Seeing unexpected GPU node evictions from the warm pool. anyone seeing related alerts?
DeployBot: alert: gpu-node-eviction spike detected in eu-west-2 - 12 nodes in 4m. linked incidents: INC-4321
Sara (eng-infra): yep I'm on it. logs show keystore decrypt errors during node bootstrap, KMS 403s. suspect new egress deny to keystore proxy.
Sara (eng-infra): snippet: ```2024-04-12T14:03:12Z keystore-client ERROR decrypt failed status=403 "AccessDenied" key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:...```
Priya (eng-security): we pushed the tighter egress policy to block direct outbound to external telemetry endpoints, intended to force traffic via privatelink. Did we miss the keystore proxy CIDR?
Max (eng-platform): oof. the rollout had a shortlist: collector IPs + privatelink endpoints. sounds like keystore proxy IP wasn't included.
Josh (eng-sre): consequence: nodes can't decrypt disk/keystore, kubelet fails readiness -> cordon + eviction. Warm pool drops -> provisioning spiky and capacity short.
Lina (oncall): traffic capture shows nodes attempting 10.10.5.23:443 (keystore-proxy) then RST. Firewall rule table shows deny for 10.10.0.0/16? not expected.
Priya (eng-security): confirming we applied a deny-all outbound except allow list for eu-west-2. My fault if the allow list omitted keystore-proxy. rolling patch ID: fw-roll-2024-04-12-v2.
Sara (eng-infra): workaround: adding temporary allow for 10.10.5.23/32 and requeueing nodes. command I ran: ```aws ec2 modify-network-acl --network-acl-id acl-abc --ingress ...``` (manual step). nodes are coming back but warm-pool still ~60% below target.
Max (eng-platform): long term we need an automated preflight check that validates critical service egress (keystore, kms endpoints, privatelink) before denying wide ranges.
Josh (eng-sre): agree. also cost impact: autoscaler spun up new on-demand GPU instances to compensate while warm pool was unhealthy. estimate +$6k/day if left for 24h.
Priya (eng-security): immediate plan: revert fw-roll-2024-04-12-v2 in eu-west, add keystore/proxy and kms allow entries, and follow with targeted rollout that includes preflight. Will issue change ticket.
Lina (oncall): requeue complete on 8 nodes, 4 still pending (decrypt timeout). I'll keep monitoring and run a sweep to ensure no other regions affected.
Sara (eng-infra): checklist for follow-up: (1) verify privatelink endpoints resolution in tf state, (2) add keystore-proxy CIDR to allowlist, (3) create alert for KMS 4xx spikes tied to node bootstrap, (4) add e2e preflight to firewall deploy pipeline.
Max (eng-platform): tagging for postmortem? I can create a short incident doc. owners: Priya (change), Sara (remediation), Josh (capacity/cost analysis).
Priya (eng-security): putting change revert in progress now. will ping when done. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: change fw-roll-2024-04-12-v2 reverted in eu-west at 14:15 UTC by priya. revert-id: change-5823
Lina (oncall): warm pool back to 90% target, autoscaler paused scale-up. still monitoring KMS error logs for 10m window.
Josh (eng-sre): cost hit estimate recalculated: ~ $1.5k for the full incident window after partial rollback. need to reconcile billing.
Max (eng-platform): thanks all. follow-up action items in #eng-platform backlog. we'll post a brief blameless postmortem and add egress preflight gating to deploy pipeline. :memo:
